definitions.explanation: An official statement predicting future conditions, especially weather.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}によると、{明日|あした}は{雨|あめ}だ。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {週間|しゅうかん}{予報|よほう}をチェックする。

notes:
USAGE: {予報|よほう} is most commonly used for weather forecasts ({天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}), but can also be used for other types of official predictions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう} (weather forecast)
・{週間|しゅうかん}{予報|よほう} (weekly forecast)
・{予報|よほう}{士|し} (weather forecaster)
・{予報|よほう}が{当|あ}たる (forecast is accurate)
・{予報|よほう}が{外|はず}れる (forecast is wrong)

RELATED:
・{予測|よそく} - prediction (analytical)
・{予想|よそう} - expectation, prediction
